title: Franco contextual note values: complete bounded groups change the same lozenge duration
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. Franco chapterV gives a complete five-note3|2 teaching example whose same-shaped semibreves have durations1,1,1,1,2 under explicit group rules. Equal-total rivals preserve note counts and even group totals but move onsets. Complete IV–V source, witness differences and missing target writer retained; no music-decoder reopening.

known_state: explicit division between unequal adjacent group sizes
rules: Three semibreves representing a recta are all minor.
Two representing a recta are minor then major; major equals two minors.
The same lozenge shape represents both.
The separator partitions groups without adding sounded time.
historically_fixed_realization.finite_function: duration(k,j)=2u if k=2 and j=2; otherwise u for k in{2,3} and1<=j<=k.
historically_fixed_realization.symbols: S,D,u,k,j are our bookkeeping; none is an EVA or historical letter value.
